strings.name: Shantanu Narayen
strings.role: Adobe chair and chief executive officer
strings.summary: Narayen rose from engineering to lead Adobe’s shift from perpetual creative-software licenses to cloud subscriptions, alongside digital documents, marketing and generative AI. His earlier work included Apple, Silicon Graphics and a startup. In 2026 Adobe announced a December succession: Anil Chakravarthy would become CEO and Narayen executive chair. That change had not taken effect by the cutoff.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Led Adobe’s creative-software subscription and digital-experience businesses, influencing design, publishing and digital-content tools.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Electronics degree, Osmania University; computer-science master’s, Bowling Green State; MBA, Berkeley Haas.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Changing the creative-software model
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led Adobe’s move toward cloud subscriptions and continuously updated services.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Digital experience and AI
strings.highlights.h2.text: Expanded enterprise digital experience and advanced generative tools including Firefly.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Succession announced
strings.timeline.t1.text: Adobe announced Chakravarthy would become CEO on December 1, with Narayen moving to executive chair.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Generative-AI interview published
strings.timeline.t2.text: Stanford published an interview exploring Firefly and AI’s place in creative workflows.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Became board chair
strings.timeline.t3.text: Added Adobe’s chairmanship after several years as chief executive.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Creative development moved to Creative Cloud
strings.timeline.t9.text: Adobe announced future creative-product innovations would go to Creative Cloud subscribers; CS 6 perpetual licenses remained on sale and supported.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Became CEO
strings.timeline.t4.text: Took charge of Adobe, subsequently reshaping its business model and product portfolio.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Became president and COO
strings.timeline.t5.text: Advanced to president and chief operating officer, overseeing products and operations.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joined Adobe
strings.timeline.t6.text: Joined as vice president and general manager of the engineering technology group.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Cofounded Pictra
strings.timeline.t7.text: Helped establish an internet photo-sharing software company, gaining digital-imaging startup experience.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Earned an MBA
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed his business-administration master’s at the University of California, Berkeley’s Haas School.
